subject: general
question: Which of the following states of India has the highest number (absolute) of people living in rural areas according to the census of India 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Census of India 2011**

 
 
• In **2011,** the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh** had the highest number of **rural inhabitants.**
 
• It has a 155 million rural population. It is** 18.6 %** of the **total rural population of India.**
 
• **Bihar stood second** in line with approximately **92 million people** living in the rural areas during the same time period.
 
• According to the 2011 census, **68.84 %** population in India lives in rural areas. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state of **Maharashtra** had the highest population with over **50 million people living in urban areas.**
 
• According to the 2011 census, 68.84 % population in India lives in rural areas.
 
• The level of urbanization increased from **27.81%** in the 2001 Census to **31.16%** in the 2011 Census, while the proportion of the rural population declined from **72.19% to 68.84%.**
